title: asyneuma amplexicaule subsp. aucheri
intro: Asyneuma amplexicaule subsp. aucheri, commonly known as Persian thyme, is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Persian thyme include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
